response.reasoning: Accurate and grounded: `admin-embedding.js.es6` defines `saveChanges()` calling `this.get('embedding').update({})`, but the new `embedding.hbs` template contains no button or action wired to `saveChanges` (only addHost/deleteHost are used). Server-side, `config/routes.rb` adds `put "customize/embedding" => "embedding#update"` and `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` only re-serializes `@embedding` without persisting anything. So the PUT endpoint and the client action are genuinely no-ops/dead code in this diff. This is a real, specific review concern (dead no-op endpoint plus unwired action that future maintainers may assume persists data), not a correctness defect in shipped behavior, so it is not a bug.
